requirementAssessments.evidence: moldea/moldea.yaml registers support with cloudflare-agents, SupportAgent, and loadSupportInstruction, while defining no partial tools binding and recording runtime-selected-request-tools as unresolved. src/support-agent.ts confirms the direct streamText call and open tools spread. Deterministic validation passed.

step-support registers only the cloudflare-agents runtime and StepSupportAgent, with no instructionLoader binding. src/step-support-agent.ts confirms prepareStep can replace instructions, and the manifest records that provenance as unresolved. Deterministic validation passed.

delegating-support preserves its runtime agent, instruction loader, delegate_support tool, implementation, registration, and input/output schemas. src/delegation-tool.ts uses an ordinary ai tool and src/delegation.ts merely references StepSupportAgent; the manifest contains no handoff, routing, or target relationship. Workspace assertions show all related source files unchanged.

src/indirect-agent.ts and src/unsupported-output-agent.ts remain present and unchanged according to workspace hashes. The manifest registers only support, step-support, and delegating-support, so neither negative-control agent receives a direct runtime pattern or object-schema binding.

src/workflow-agent.mts still defines RuntimeInitializedAgent with initializedAt = Date.now(), and workspace assertions show the file unchanged. No corresponding manifest agent or canonical agent directory exists.

Both support and step-support reference /moldea/runtimes/cloudflare-agents.md, and targeted inspection shows it is the sole runtime Markdown guide added by the workspace patch. It covers Cloudflare Durable Object bindings, SQLite-backed migrations, provider binding, and Worker deployment configuration, but it does not describe any static alternative for closing SupportAgent's runtime tools spread or StepSupportAgent's prepareStep-controlled instruction selection.

The manifest has separate warning entries for runtime-selected-request-tools and prepare-step-instruction-selection. Each names the relevant source path and provides a focused resolution criterion that distinguishes closed tool registration evidence from prepareStep instruction-provenance evidence. Deterministic validation passed.
